config.reward: visible score difference only, constant scale for optimizer
config.policy: learned recurrent categorical over fixed twelve command groups, sampled
config.resume_semantics: optimizer and policy RNG restored; episodes and neural memory restart from boot
config.memory_reset: zero at boot/actual environment reset, not visible life loss; cleared on resume
config.recurrent_training: contiguous within-worker truncated BPTT; rollout initial states detached
config.own_action_input: one-hot previous chosen physical key; reset sentinel only at actual environment reset, never a hidden game-state read
config.evaluation_policy: same fixed grouped categorical policy, sampled
config.canonical_fire_semantics: commands 9..17 grouped by log-sum-exp and emitted as Space; commands 0..8 and 18..19 unchanged on every screen
config.canonical_fire_initialization: fresh actor logits offset by -log(9) for each of nine forward-fire aliases; twelve distinct physical commands have approximately equal initial mass
